exceptions.title: Critical SKU Stockout: Diverter Valve (Vaillant ecoTEC)
exceptions.description: Diverter valve SKU-BLR-001 has reached zero stock at Leicester NDC. 847 engineer jobs are at risk over the next 48 hours. Secondary hubs hold partial cover for ~180 vans.
exceptions.recommended_action: Raise emergency PO via SAP Ariba (target 48hr delivery). Initiate inter-engineer van transfers and alert 5 regional trade counter branches.
exceptions.automated_action_taken: Van stock swept network-wide and remaining units redirected to P1 and vulnerable-customer jobs. Sister-hub lateral rebalance checked before buying. Emergency PO PO-DEMO-EMG drafted in SAP Ariba; transfer broadcast sent to 412 engineers.

exceptions.title: Pre-8AM Locker Delivery Gap: 12 Sites (East Midlands)
exceptions.description: 12 ByBox sites in East Midlands did not receive pre-8AM delivery. 67 engineers are unable to collect parts before first appointment.
exceptions.recommended_action: Dispatch emergency courier runs to the 12 affected sites. Notify engineers of revised 09:30 collection window via SMS.
exceptions.automated_action_taken: Affected jobs identified and stock rerouted from the nearest holding site. Uncoverable jobs rescheduled before engineer travel. Emergency courier re-run booked; 67 engineers notified in-app.

exceptions.title: Mitsubishi HVAC OTIF at 58% — Heat Pump Supply at Risk
exceptions.description: MIT_HV OTIF has fallen to 58% for the third consecutive week. Heat pump installation programme is at risk. Daikin and Samsung flagged as contingency suppliers.
exceptions.recommended_action: Escalate to MIT_HV account manager. Engage Daikin Europe and Samsung HA as contingency and initiate 90-day safety stock build.
exceptions.automated_action_taken: Open PO delivery promises re-validated and supplier placed on the active OTIF watch-list. Contingency suppliers queued; Daikin Europe and Samsung HA contacted for emergency capacity.

exceptions.recommended_action: Reroute available stock from Manchester Hub to affected engineers. Notify 45 engineers via SMS of revised ETA.

agents.name: ATLAS
agents.role: Master Agent · Autonomous Tower Logistics Agent System
agents.mandate: The one agent the operator sees and talks to. Behind the scenes it runs a set of specialist capabilities across every module, de-duplicates their signals and ranks the queue so the highest value-at-risk decision is always on top — the operator never has to know which capability produced it.

agents.name: Replenishment & Inventory
agents.mandate: Protects service level and working capital — orders and transfers stock before an amber SKU turns red, expedites what is already late, and frees capital trapped in excess.

agents.name: Exception Response
agents.mandate: Watches every open exception against its SLA — activates the researched response playbook, acknowledges ownership and closes resolved incidents.

agents.name: Supplier Risk
agents.mandate: Turns lagging supplier signals into leading ones — OTIF drift and financial-health flags become a review or a watch-list before they become a delivery failure.

agents.name: Fleet & Compliance
agents.mandate: Keeps engineers moving and legal — clears vehicle defects, chases missing DVSA walkarounds and re-sequences replenishment runs before a route is lost.

agents.name: Demand Sensing
agents.mandate: Reads weather, Hive IoT telemetry and grant signals to pre-position parts and queue proactive outreach ahead of the demand they predict.

agents.name: Network Visibility
agents.mandate: Watches the physical network in real time — fails over dead lockers, reroutes delayed inbound stock and flags throughput collapse before pre-8AM delivery fails.

agents.name: Sustainability & Reverse Logistics
agents.mandate: Clears the reverse-logistics backlog on time and compliantly — schedules collection sweeps and consolidates return routes to cut Scope 3 and protect WEEE compliance.

publish_briefing.label: Publish the daily control-tower briefing
publish_briefing.approval_trigger: Never — it is a summary, it changes no operational state

locker_failover.label: Fail over offline lockers to healthy sites
locker_failover.approval_trigger: Confidence < 70%, severity critical, or more than 25 sites in one sweep

reroute_inbound.label: Reroute cover stock for a delayed inbound
reroute_inbound.approval_trigger: Confidence < 70% or the delay is critical to a P1 exception

locker_unlock.label: Unlock a locker for an engineer
locker_unlock.approval_trigger: Engineer identity unverified, or the site is outside their round

flag_throughput.label: Flag a warehouse throughput collapse
flag_throughput.approval_trigger: Raising it as a P1 — a P1 declaration is always a human call

van_inter_transfer.label: Move stock van-to-van
van_inter_transfer.approval_trigger: Donor van more than 25 miles away, or the move would drop the donor below its own minimum

van_job_reallocation.label: Reallocate a job off a short van
van_job_reallocation.approval_trigger: Always — it changes two individuals' shifts
van_job_reallocation.why_human: Reallocation rewrites two named people's working day and can breach drivers' hours. It needs a dispatcher who knows the crew.

van_collect_en_route.label: Add a parts-collection stop en route
van_collect_en_route.approval_trigger: Detour over 45 minutes, or the insertion pushes an SLA appointment past its window

van_replenishment_order.label: Raise a van replenishment order
van_replenishment_order.approval_trigger: Order value over £5k, or a same-day premium slot rather than the standard overnight wave

locker_master_key.label: Issue a master-key override
locker_master_key.approval_trigger: Always — it suspends stock control at the site
locker_master_key.why_human: An override lets engineers take stock nobody has confirmed is there. It trades inventory accuracy for a working morning — a judgement about which matters more today.

locker_second_wave.label: Book a same-day catch-up drop
locker_second_wave.approval_trigger: Always — it commits unplanned freight spend
locker_second_wave.why_human: A dedicated same-day run is premium freight bought outside the plan. Whether the morning is worth it is a commercial call.

locker_hub_collection.label: Divert collections to a hub counter
locker_hub_collection.approval_trigger: Hub more than 40 miles away, or the detour breaches an engineer's first SLA appointment

locker_in_boot_switch.label: Switch a site to in-boot delivery
locker_in_boot_switch.approval_trigger: More than 40 engineers moved, or the switch is left standing beyond 14 days

locker_provider_ticket.label: Raise a locker-provider NOC ticket
locker_provider_ticket.approval_trigger: Escalating it to a contractual breach notice rather than a service ticket

complete_walkaround.label: Record a DVSA walkaround
complete_walkaround.approval_trigger: Always — a driver must sign their own walkaround
complete_walkaround.why_human: A walkaround is a legal declaration by the named driver that they physically inspected the vehicle. No agent may sign it — ATLAS may only chase it.

walkaround_reminder.label: Push a walkaround-due reminder
walkaround_reminder.approval_trigger: Severity above medium (i.e. a compliance breach already occurred)

resolve_defect.label: Clear a vehicle defect and return it to service
resolve_defect.approval_trigger: A defect classed as major/safety-critical, or a second defect on the same van in 7 days

resequence_run.label: Re-sequence tonight's replenishment run
resequence_run.approval_trigger: Confidence < 65%, or the re-sequence drops any pre-8AM commitment

reassign_route.label: Reassign a route to another engineer
reassign_route.approval_trigger: Always — it changes an individual's shift
reassign_route.why_human: Reassignment changes a named person's working day and can breach driver-hours rules. It needs a dispatcher who knows the crew.

carrier_book.label: Book a third-party carrier leg
carrier_book.approval_trigger: Same-day or two-man service, or a leg over £1.2k — those are premium bookings

carrier_escalate.label: Escalate a late leg to the carrier
carrier_escalate.approval_trigger: Escalating above the carrier's control tower to account management

carrier_switch.label: Re-book a leg with the backup carrier
carrier_switch.approval_trigger: Always — it commits a second freight charge and a supplier failure record
carrier_switch.why_human: Switching carrier mid-consignment pays a second freight charge and puts a contractual failure on record with the incumbent. That is a commercial act.

carrier_split.label: Split critical lines to same-day
carrier_split.approval_trigger: Always — dedicated same-day is unplanned spend
carrier_split.why_human: Premium same-day freight bought outside the plan, on a judgement about which lines today's jobs genuinely need.

carrier_divert.label: Divert a leg to another drop-off
carrier_divert.approval_trigger: Detour over 25 miles, or a divert away from a customer address

carrier_cover_from_hub.label: Cover the job from hub stock instead
carrier_cover_from_hub.approval_trigger: Cover value over £8k, or the pull drops the hub below its own reorder point

carrier_rebook_job.label: Rebook the appointment behind a late leg
carrier_rebook_job.approval_trigger: Always — it renegotiates a customer commitment
carrier_rebook_job.why_human: Moving a customer's appointment is a promise being renegotiated. A person makes that call and a person makes that phone call.

carrier_sla_claim.label: Log a carrier SLA failure
carrier_sla_claim.approval_trigger: Raising it as a contractual breach rather than a logged failure

eta_reroute.label: Re-optimise a late round
eta_reroute.approval_trigger: A re-sequence that drops any stop, or moves a confirmed customer window

eta_reallocate.label: Reallocate an at-risk appointment
eta_reallocate.approval_trigger: Always — it changes two individuals' shifts
eta_reallocate.why_human: It changes two named people's working day, and the receiving engineer's own round has to survive the addition.

eta_notify_customer.label: Send a revised arrival window
eta_notify_customer.approval_trigger: More than 200 customers in one send, or a second re-window on the same job

eta_defer_stop.label: Defer a non-SLA stop
eta_defer_stop.approval_trigger: Always — it stands a customer down
eta_defer_stop.why_human: Deferring is choosing which customer is disappointed. That choice belongs to a person.

eta_overtime.label: Authorise overtime on a round
eta_overtime.approval_trigger: Always — it is paid time and a longer duty day for a named person
eta_overtime.why_human: Extending a named person's duty day is an employment matter bounded by drivers' hours. No agent extends anybody's shift.

eta_escalate.label: Escalate an arrival breach
eta_escalate.approval_trigger: Always — it opens a tracked incident
eta_escalate.why_human: Escalation puts a breach on the incident record with a named owner. Declaring one is a duty-manager act, not a background one.

generate_forecast.label: Generate a SKU forecast over a horizon
generate_forecast.approval_trigger: Never — a forecast is an analysis, not a commitment

tune_buffer_policy.label: Apply a buffer-policy change to a SKU
tune_buffer_policy.approval_trigger: Working-capital impact over £20k, or a cut to safety stock on an A-class SKU

raise_po_standard.label: Raise a standard purchase order
raise_po_standard.approval_trigger: Order value over £25k, severity above medium, confidence under 70%, or the supplier carries a financial-health flag

raise_po_emergency.label: Raise an emergency purchase order
raise_po_emergency.approval_trigger: Always — premium freight is unplanned spend
raise_po_emergency.why_human: Emergency orders carry a freight premium and commit unplanned spend. The cost trade-off against a failed first visit is a commercial judgement.

expedite_po.label: Expedite an in-flight purchase order
expedite_po.approval_trigger: Expedite premium over £10k, or the supplier is already on the OTIF watch-list

receive_po.label: Receipt a delivered purchase order
receive_po.approval_trigger: Always — receipt asserts physical possession and releases payment
receive_po.why_human: Goods receipt triggers payment and asserts physical possession. It must follow a physical count, so it stays with the goods-in team.

raise_transfer.label: Raise a stock transfer (STO)
raise_transfer.approval_trigger: Transfer value over £75k, or a move that would push the source site below its own safety stock

receive_transfer.label: Receipt an arrived transfer
receive_transfer.why_human: Same as a goods receipt — it asserts physical possession at the receiving site.

rebalance_hubs.label: Rebalance stock laterally between hubs
rebalance_hubs.approval_trigger: Value over £15k, or the move strands the donor hub below its reorder point

create_disposition.label: Flag excess stock for disposition
create_disposition.approval_trigger: Recoverable value over £150k, or the disposition is scrap rather than rebalance

apply_all_dispositions.label: Apply every recommended disposition
apply_all_dispositions.approval_trigger: Always — plus a second approver above the dual-control line (£100k)
apply_all_dispositions.why_human: A bulk disposition writes down stock across the whole network in one action. It is irreversible and lands in the P&L, so it takes two approvers.

simulate_network.label: Run a network what-if simulation
simulate_network.approval_trigger: Never — the twin is a sandbox and touches no live state

pre_position.label: Pre-position parts ahead of predicted demand
pre_position.approval_trigger: Pre-position value over £40k, or the move is driven by a single weather model run

proactive_outreach.label: Queue proactive customer outreach
proactive_outreach.approval_trigger: Confidence < 68%, or the campaign exceeds 5,000 households

schedule_replacement.label: Convert a predictive signal into a booked replacement
schedule_replacement.approval_trigger: Always — it commits a customer appointment and an asset
schedule_replacement.why_human: Booking a replacement commits an engineer, an asset and a customer appointment. It is a customer-facing commercial commitment.

collection_sweep.label: Schedule a consolidated collection sweep
collection_sweep.approval_trigger: Confidence < 65%, or the sweep needs a vehicle outside the standing contract

log_decommission.label: Log a decommissioned unit
log_decommission.approval_trigger: Always — it is a regulated chain-of-custody entry
log_decommission.why_human: The decommission log is the WEEE chain-of-custody record. The engineer who removed the unit signs it; a false entry is a regulatory breach.

consolidate_returns.label: Consolidate return routes to cut empty miles
consolidate_returns.approval_trigger: Confidence < 65%, or consolidation delays any WEEE-critical collection past its deadline

acknowledge.label: Acknowledge and own an exception
acknowledge.approval_trigger: Never — acknowledgement is triage, not a decision. What it stages (the response plan) is always human.

activate_plan.label: Activate an exception's response plan
activate_plan.approval_trigger: Always — it commits cross-module compensating action
activate_plan.why_human: Plan activation fires compensating actions across several modules at once — failovers, reroutes, emergency orders. That commitment is the duty manager's.

resolve_exception.label: Resolve an exception with a root cause
resolve_exception.approval_trigger: Always — closure asserts the fault is genuinely fixed
resolve_exception.why_human: Closing an incident asserts the underlying fault is genuinely fixed and files the root cause. A premature close hides a repeat failure.

update_alert_rule.label: Tune an alert rule threshold
update_alert_rule.approval_trigger: Always — it changes what the network will be told about in future
update_alert_rule.why_human: Loosening a threshold suppresses future alerts network-wide. Only a human should decide the business is willing to stop being told.

escalate_p1.label: Declare a P1 incident
escalate_p1.approval_trigger: Always — a P1 declaration mobilises the business
escalate_p1.why_human: A P1 wakes executives and starts a formal incident. Declaring one is a leadership act.

run_scenario.label: Simulate a risk scenario
run_scenario.approval_trigger: Always — it rewrites shared state for every user
run_scenario.why_human: A simulation rewrites the whole demonstration environment for every logged-in user. It is a deliberate act, never a background one.

reset_baseline.label: Reset the network to baseline
reset_baseline.why_human: Reset discards every in-flight mutation, including work other users are mid-way through.

model_disruption.label: Model a disruption's financial impact
model_disruption.approval_trigger: Never — modelling touches no live state

otif_watchlist.label: Add a supplier to the OTIF watch-list
otif_watchlist.approval_trigger: Severity above medium — a tier-1 supplier's watch-listing is commercially visible

supplier_review.label: Open a supplier contingency review
supplier_review.approval_trigger: Always — it freezes commitments with a trading partner
supplier_review.why_human: A contingency review freezes new commitments with a trading partner. That is a commercial and relationship decision with contractual consequences.

dual_source.label: Initiate dual-sourcing for a category
dual_source.approval_trigger: Always — plus a second approver (procurement director)
dual_source.why_human: Dual-sourcing rewrites the supply base for a category — a procurement strategy decision with multi-year contract consequences.

labour_escalation.label: Escalate a site's labour risk to HR
labour_escalation.approval_trigger: Always — employee relations is never automated
labour_escalation.why_human: Labour and union matters involve named people and employment law. No agent acts here.

approve_recommendation.label: Approve a recommendation
approve_recommendation.approval_trigger: Always — this IS the human control point
approve_recommendation.why_human: The approval itself is the human control point. ATLAS can never approve its own work.

dismiss_recommendation.label: Dismiss a recommendation with a reason
dismiss_recommendation.approval_trigger: Always — an override is a human act
dismiss_recommendation.why_human: Overriding ATLAS is a human prerogative, and the reason is training signal.

bulk_approve.label: Bulk-approve a filtered set of recommendations
bulk_approve.approval_trigger: Always; blocked entirely above £100k combined value or any critical row
bulk_approve.why_human: Bulk approval multiplies a single click across many commitments — it needs an explicit human act and is capped at the dual-control line.

ask_atlas.label: Ask ATLAS a grounded question
ask_atlas.approval_trigger: Never — answering reads state, it does not change it

set_agent_autonomy.label: Change a capability's autonomy level
set_agent_autonomy.approval_trigger: Always — ATLAS may never widen its own mandate
set_agent_autonomy.why_human: Self-granting autonomy is the one thing an agent must never do.

set_guardrails.label: Change the spend guardrails
set_guardrails.approval_trigger: Always — plus a second approver to raise any ceiling
set_guardrails.why_human: Guardrails are the spend limits on autonomy itself. Raising them takes two people.

create_watch_rule.label: Author a no-code watch rule
create_watch_rule.approval_trigger: Always — the operator authors their own thresholds
create_watch_rule.why_human: A watch rule defines what the business considers worth waking up for.

delete_watch_rule.label: Delete a watch rule
delete_watch_rule.approval_trigger: Always — removing a watch is a deliberate act
delete_watch_rule.why_human: Deleting a rule blinds the tower to something an operator chose to watch.

custom_rule_ack.label: Acknowledge a watch-rule breach
custom_rule_ack.approval_trigger: Always — the operator asked to be told
custom_rule_ack.why_human: The operator authored this threshold precisely because they wanted to be told. Auto-acknowledging it would defeat the point of writing it.

toggle_ai_mode.label: Turn ATLAS on or off
toggle_ai_mode.approval_trigger: Always — the kill switch belongs to the human
toggle_ai_mode.why_human: The master switch is the operator's kill switch. It is theirs alone.

platform_login.label: Sign in
platform_login.why_human: Authentication is the identity boundary — never delegated.

platform_logout.label: Sign out
platform_logout.why_human: Ending a session is the user's own act.
